description: Step one of selling an Operator you hold: reads that your wallet holds the token, whether Seaport may move it (if not, returns the one approval transaction your wallet sends first) and your Seaport counter, then returns the EIP-712 typed data your wallet signs (eth_signTypedData_v4: a signature, not a transaction). Step two is operator_list with the listing and that signature. Nothing is signed or sent here.

days.description: how long the listing stays open (1 to 180, default 30)

price_eth.description: the price in the chain's native coin, a plain decimal like 0.05

wallet.description: the 0x address of the wallet that holds the Operator

name: operator_sell
